source_notes.beaches_2023: Municipal Tourism Yearbook 2024 revised edition, base 2023, p.15. Expanded mobile-phone visitor estimates, minimum 30-minute stay, annual sum of monthly counts. Daily trip equivalents are modeled, not measured daily trips or unique annual visitors. Locals and tourists included. Shared beach totals are split only once; residential origins proxy visitors and accommodation.
